agent/backup.answer: Tracker stores its data in a SQLite file named `tasks.db` inside the list folder, which defaults to `~/.tracker`. To back up every task, tag, and comment, back up that `tasks.db` file. Make sure to close running tracker commands before copying it.

tool_outputs.content:
[{"id": "storage", "text": "Where tracker stores data
Each task list is one SQLite file named tasks.db inside the list folder, ~/.tracker by default. Back up that file to back up every task, tag and comment. Close running tracker commands before you copy it."}, {"id": "debug", "text": "Debug logging
`--debug` writes request details to debug.log in the list folder. Version 2.4.1 redacts API tokens in debug output; earlier versions do not."}, {"id": "archive", "text": "Archive and delete
`tracker archive ID` hides a task from `tracker list` but keeps it in tasks.db; `tracker restore ID` brings it back. `tracker delete ID` removes the task permanently and cannot be undone."}]

agent/config-keys.answer: You can include `default_project`, `week_start` (set to `monday` or `sunday`), `color` (set to `auto`, `always`, or `never`), and `editor` in `config.toml`.

tool_outputs.content:
[{"id": "config", "text": "Configuration keys
tracker reads config.toml from the list folder. Allowed keys are default_project, week_start (monday or sunday), color (auto, always or never) and editor."}, {"id": "output", "text": "Output formats
`tracker list` prints a table. Color follows the color setting; with color = auto, tracker turns color off when standard output is not a terminal. `tracker list --format csv` prints comma-separated rows."}, {"id": "tokens", "text": "API tokens
`tracker login` stores an API token in the system keychain. `tracker logout` removes it. Tokens expire after 90 days; run `tracker login` again to get a new one."}]

agent/pipe-colors.answer: Color output follows the `color` setting. Set `color = auto` so that tracker automatically turns color off when standard output is not a terminal (such as when piped to `grep`). Alternatively, you can use `tracker list --format csv` for comma-separated output without table formatting.
